name: Historical data sample: 2026-10-02 (14.4 h)
body:
Verified sample of the historical pump.fun / PumpSwap dataset (DATA-1, PR #16). Not committed to git.

Coverage: slots 452542500 to 452735999, block times 2026-10-02 07:27:23 to 21:49:58 UTC (14.4 h, one partial day, warm-up: tokens created before 07:27 are outside the universes). Parent-linked: 0 breaks. Decode failures: 0.
Universe: hash(mint) < 0.05 for launch, grad and direct_pool, 72 h tapes (see manifest `sampling`, `universe_counts`: {"direct_pool": 3, "grad": 44, "launch": 1529, "mints_registered": 30718}).
Program upgrade boundary inside this slice: manifest key `program_upgrade_2026_10_02` (first extra-bytes trade event at slot 452654883, 2026-10-02 15:07:07 UTC).

Checks (qa-report.md): curve real reserves rebuild 158,423/158,423; PumpSwap reserve chain 239,892/239,892; PumpSwap vault balances 235,807/235,807; curve token balances 152,898/152,898; 54/54 idle curves and pools equal live on-chain state; GeckoTerminal 1-minute close median difference 1.2% (232 minutes).
